data.name: Ananta
data.long_meaning: Ananta is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'ananta', which means 'endless' or 'infinite'. In Hindu mythology, Ananta is the name of the serpent king who supports the universe. He is also known as 'Shesha Nag' and is depicted as an endless coil, symbolizing the infinite nature of the universe and the cycle of life.
